findings.title: Pass 2 lacks a post-commit progress-persistence replay barrier
evidence: SequentialScanRunner commits Pass 2 knowledge and then persists Completed without the Pass 1 replay-and-retry guard.
If final progress persistence fails, re-entry dispatches again and a new ReceivedAt changes the materialization timestamp.
Exact durable replay then conflicts and the runner can mark the Scan Failed despite a visible Business Logic Document.

findings.title: Prepared Pass 1 documents may omit all required communication evidence
evidence: Production supplies a nonempty approved communication-evidence allowlist.
Result validation and commit validation still permit CommunicationEvidenceIds to be empty.
The relational scenario returns empty communication evidence and commits successfully.
No migration, model snapshot, API, UI, or Docker drift.
Review was read-only and left the worktree clean.
